title: Respecting Someone's Time
paragraphs: Every time he scheduled a meeting, Tariq arrived exactly on time, a habit he inherited from his father, who always said that being late was a subtle way of telling someone their time did not matter.

One day, a business partner arrived twenty-five minutes late without any apology or explanation, and Tariq found himself unexpectedly frustrated, more than he thought such a small delay should reasonably cause.

Rather than saying nothing, Tariq mentioned politely afterward that he had rearranged his entire afternoon to accommodate the original meeting time, hoping to explain his frustration without sounding overly harsh.

The partner apologized sincerely and explained a genuine emergency had come up, which Tariq accepted completely, realizing that respecting time worked both ways: through punctuality, but also through honest communication when delays happen.
